liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Away From The Mire** (1 review): The opening pairing of Away From The Mire into Long Forgotten Dream sounds especially good on this recording [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Living Like An Animal > New Country Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **Likes of Me > Pyramid Country > Secrets**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **The Fire On My Tongue > BronzeBack**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **All Time Low > Steam Powered Aereo Plane**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2022-05-12.InsideOut_TLM102_ck63** (recommended): source not stated; 18 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording captures the band's energetic performance well [6]
- **billystrings2022-05-12.InsideOut_TLM102**: source not stated; 18 songs; 154 min [2]
- **billystrings2022-05-12.InsideOut_NeumannTLM102_AKGck63**: source not stated; 18 songs; 154 min [3]
- **billystrings2022-05-12.InsideOut_AKG.ck63**: source not stated; 18 songs; 154 min [4]

## Around the show

- The show opened the 2022 season at Red Rocks [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2022-05-12.InsideOut_TLM102_ck63**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: Neumann TLM102 + AKG ck63 > SD MixPre-10ii [1]. Also: Source 2 chain: AKG ck63, nbob actives, naiant pfa, then an SD MixPre-10ii recorder [1]
- **billystrings2022-05-12.InsideOut_TLM102**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: Neumann TLM 102 (NOS) > Gakables > SD MixPre-10ii [2]
- **billystrings2022-05-12.InsideOut_NeumannTLM102_AKGck63**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: Neumann TLM102 + AKG ck63 > SD MixPre-10ii [3]. Also: Source 1 chain: Neumann TLM 102 (NOS) through GAKables into an SD MixPre-10ii recorder; Source 2 chain: AKG ck63 (PAS), nbob actives, naiant pfa, then an SD MixPre-10ii recorder [3]
- **billystrings2022-05-12.InsideOut_AKG.ck63**: taped by HealthCov Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: AKG ck63 > Nbob actives > Naiant pfa > SD MixPre-10ii [4]
